description: Louisiana 211 connects people in all 64 parishes with local health and human services. Specialists can help identify options when a household needs several kinds of support.
introduction: Louisiana 211 connects people in all 64 parishes with local health and human services. Specialists can help identify options when a household needs several kinds of support.

who: Anyone in Louisiana can ask for information and referrals.
A referred organization conducts its own eligibility review and decides whether assistance is available.
sections.get: A confidential specialist conversation can identify relevant providers and contacts. Telephone service operates 24 hours a day, seven days a week, with language interpretation available.
sections.docs: Have your ZIP code, parish, immediate need and any deadline ready. Write down providers already contacted so the specialist can look for another option. These are preparation suggestions; 211 does not require a benefit application for a referral.
sections.apply:
1. Dial 211 or text your ZIP code to 898211.
  2. Explain your location and whether the problem involves a deadline, such as an eviction hearing or disconnection.
  3. Ask for the provider’s intake details and contact it directly.
sections.after: Keep a referral list and note each response. If an organization cannot serve you, ask 211 about alternatives and explain the obstacle. For immediate danger, contact emergency services rather than waiting for a community referral.

faqs: Does the network cover my parish?
The Louisiana 211 network states that it covers all 64 parishes.
Can I reach someone at night?
The telephone service advertises help 24 hours a day, seven days a week.
How do I get a referral by text?
Text your ZIP code to 898211. Explain your need when the team responds.
It provides referrals. The utility assistance provider decides whether to accept an application and make a payment.
